text.p: Universal Hospital Services Inc said a special committee of the board and the financial adviser it hired, Piper Jaffray Inc, received at least four preliminary indications of interest to acquire the company.
The company also said it received a preliminary indication of interest from a major healthcare company to form a strategic alliance.
Among the parties interested in acquiring the company is a group comprising certain management employees of Universal Hospital.
The company said all indications of interest are at a very early stage and are subject to due diligence, negotiations and other factors.

Universal Hospital said additional alternatives may become available to the company. Its special committee said no conclusions should be drawn at this time as to the effect this process will have on enhancing shareholder value.

The special committee, made up of the company's outside directors, was established to carry out a process announced November 11 to explore alternatives for enhancing shareholder value, including the possible sale of the company.
Universal Hospital provides movable medical equipment to hospitals and other healthcare providers through equipment management programs.
